visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Closures and nonlocal
visualizerParams.description: An inner function can read the variables of the function around it. To assign to one, declare it nonlocal, otherwise Python creates a new local variable.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
def make_counter():
    count = 0

    def increment():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return count

    return increment


a = make_counter()
b = make_counter()
print(a(), a(), b())
